purpose: Single shared source map for ordinary ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work. Both must read this before claiming a source is unavailable.
rules: Prefer official Hyundai PDF or official Hyundai web manual.
Store public PDF URL, public web page URL, image key/name, and eventual repo-local extracted asset path together.
If one surface cannot open a PDF/image directly, use the other URL or repo-local asset path. Do not stop the workflow only because one surface cannot render a source.
When Work extracts an embedded image, save it under images/source/ or the final item folder and write the repo path back here.
Never replace a verified source silently; append alternates and keep provenance.
